thread:
Maya: quick sync 1 - I'm finalizing the "burst credit governance" piece for the dedicated roadmap. Major asks from legal/finops/customers: consent flow for turning on carryover, an explicit audit trail for evictions, and a clear SLA mapping. Need flags on feasibility and launch gates.
Arjun: feasibility: carryover is a ledger change (easy), but carrying tokens into instant slots needs allocator mapping. We can mark carryover tokens as lower priority so they redeem into opportunistic slots first. Technical risk: sudden redemption can cause cache misses and latency spikes.
Sienna: ops: must have per-tenant eviction audit logs with request ids, timestamp, reason (preempt/carryover_redeem), and an alert. Also recommend throttles on carryover redemption to avoid flash warm-up storms.
Leo: Customer asks: they want an explicit opt-in checkbox in console + email consent before carryover is applied, and CSV export of eviction events for compliance. Fintech pilot insists on this.
Priya: sales: agreed - buyers need transparency. We'll require a short consent workflow for pilots, with default off for enterprise until contract signed. Also we should expose a "consent_granted_at" timestamp in API.
Dan: finance: billing treatment matters. Carryover consumption should be billed as "burst (carried)" distinct line item at reduced rate. Refund/chargeback policy: no refunds for consumed carryover credits. Need clear exportable invoice lines.
Maya: proposed policy: carryover opt-in default OFF; when enabled user consents in console/API (consent timestamp stored); carryover tokens capped at 15% monthly, TTL 72h; carried tokens redeem at reduced price and are preemptible. Eviction audit and csv export included. Launch gates: consent UI, ledger + API, eviction audit export, billing lines, 2-customer pilot.
Arjun: config snippet for allocator: 
```
carryover:
  enabled: false
  cap_percent: 15
  ttl_hours: 72
  redemption_throttle_qps: 50
  redemption_priority: low
```
Arjun: note: we'll need a per-cluster global throttle to prevent too many threads warming caches concurrently.
Sienna: monitoring: tenant.evictions.csv_exportable, tenant.carryover.redeemed.count, tenant.carryover.redeem_latency.p95, cluster.carryover.redeem_rate. Alert: if redeem_latency.p95 > 2s for 5m -> pause carryover redemption. Also page if evictions > 0.5% for 15m.
Leo: pilot ask: for the fintech customer, they want carryover but disabled during 09:00-17:00 local business hours. Can we support business-hour blackout for redemption?
Maya: plan: support business-hour blackout as pilot-only feature with timezone-aware enforcement. Implementation approach: tenancy policy + enforcement in allocator. It will be manual opt-in for up to 2 customers at launch.
Priya: Sales will only propose carryover if the UI consent and audit exports are ready. I'll prep a pilot one-pager and get legal to pre-approve contract language.
rfc-bot: RFC posted: https://redwood.infra/rfc/carryover-governance-2026 - review requested by EOW.
Dan: I'll draft the invoice line templates and coordinate with revenue ops once policy is locked.
Maya: thanks all 1 - I'll update the RFC with consent flow, audit schema, and pilot checklist. Quick follow-up tomorrow 9am PT. End.
